nodes.label: main
nodes.desc: Parses CLI flags, initializes slabs, stats, threads and the main libevent loop

nodes.label: conn_new
nodes.desc: Creates a conn for a socket and selects the protocol read handler

nodes.label: drive_machine
nodes.desc: State machine: listening, waiting, reading, parsing, nread, mwrite, closing

nodes.label: dispatch_conn_new
nodes.desc: Queues a new connection onto the least-loaded worker via its notify pipe

nodes.label: setup_thread
nodes.desc: Creates each worker's libevent base, notify pipe and COLD_LRU state

nodes.label: thread_libevent_process
nodes.desc: Worker callback: drains the notify queue and hands conns to drive_machine

nodes.label: item_get
nodes.desc: Thread-safe fetch wrapper that hashes the key and bumps refcounts

nodes.label: try_read_command_ascii
nodes.desc: Scans buffered input for a CRLF-terminated text or meta command

nodes.label: process_command_ascii
nodes.desc: Central dispatcher for classic text and all meta commands (mg ms md ma me mn)

nodes.label: process_get_command
nodes.desc: Classic get/gets/gat/gats: multi-key fetch with optional CAS and touch

nodes.label: process_update_command
nodes.desc: set/add/replace/cas: reads value bytes into the freshly allocated item

nodes.label: process_meta_command
nodes.desc: me command: protocol introspection plus meta debug flags

nodes.label: process_lru_crawler_command
nodes.desc: stats lru_crawler admin command: start or stop crawls on slab classes

nodes.label: process_request
nodes.desc: Shared tokenizer for text and meta requests; extracts key, flags, TTL, value length

nodes.label: process_mget_cmd
nodes.desc: Meta get core: flag parsing, vivify, recache, stash and flash-backed reads

nodes.label: try_read_command_binary
nodes.desc: Validates a binary protocol packet header before dispatch

nodes.label: dispatch_bin_command
nodes.desc: Switch over binary opcodes: get, set, delete, SASL, stat

nodes.label: do_item_alloc
nodes.desc: Allocates an item sized to a slab class and seeds exptime and CAS

nodes.label: do_item_get
nodes.desc: Fetches a linked item, checks expiry and bumps refcount and stats

nodes.label: do_item_link
nodes.desc: Marks ITEM_LINKED, pushes item to LRU head and inserts into the hash table

nodes.label: lru_pull_tail
nodes.desc: Sweeps items off an LRU tail: evicts expired, crawls or offloads cold data

nodes.label: assoc_find
nodes.desc: Chained hash bucket walk comparing keys

nodes.label: assoc_insert
nodes.desc: Prepends the item to its hash bucket; expand thread grows the table

nodes.label: assoc_delete
nodes.desc: Removes an item pointer from its hash bucket

nodes.label: hash_init
nodes.desc: Installs the hash function: jenkins, murmur3 or xxh3

nodes.label: do_slabs_alloc
nodes.desc: Pops a free chunk from a slab class or carves a fresh page

nodes.label: do_slabs_free
nodes.desc: Returns a chunk to its slab class freelist

nodes.label: storage_get_item
nodes.desc: Builds an obj_io read for an item_hdr and submits it to extstore

nodes.label: storage_write
nodes.desc: Pulls cold items from COLD_LRU, allocates a header item and streams the body to flash

nodes.label: extstore_write
nodes.desc: Appends the io buffer to a flash page with versioning

nodes.label: lru_crawler_crawl
nodes.desc: Parses slab ids and arms crawler threads for expired or metadump runs

nodes.label: try_read_command_proxy
nodes.desc: Proxy-mode read handler buffering multi-key and multiget requests

nodes.label: proxy_process_command
nodes.desc: Builds a request object and selects the routing context for the key

nodes.label: proxy_run_rcontext
nodes.desc: Executes the Lua routing function: pool selection, retries, backend calls
